entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6173120554255287808: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 31.6386 +/- 0.0231 mas (same row, RUWE 1.36): 31.61 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 37.267, -246.011 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.374 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Mistry et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4559 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract). Mass 0.392 +/- 0.027 solar masses from Mistry et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4559 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract). Temperature 3558 +/- 73 K from Mistry et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4559 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,558 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc88e. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,558 K and log g 4.89 (u1 0.380, u2 0.383): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
